Leviathan Breach.name: Leviathan Breach
Leviathan Breach.description: The user's signature move: they rocket up out of deep water, or charge from a long running start on land, and drive their whole dense body into a target. It deals massive bludgeoning damage, knocks everyone around the impact off their feet and, from water, throws up a wall of spray that nobody can see through until the end of the user's next turn; afterward the user is winded and cannot dash until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
